definitions.explanation: A count of one hundred people.

examples.japanese: {百人|ひゃくにん}が{参加|さんか}した。
{参加者|さんかしゃ}の{数|かず}は{百人|ひゃくにん}ぐらいだった。
examples.english: The number of participants was about one hundred.

examples.japanese: {百人|ひゃくにん}{以上|いじょう}の{社員|しゃいん}がこの{会議|かいぎ}に{出席|しゅっせき}した。
examples.english: More than one hundred employees attended this meeting.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{百人一首|ひゃくにんいっしゅ} — a famous anthology of 100 poems by 100 poets, also a traditional card game

COUNTING:
{百|ひゃく} combines regularly with {人|にん}: {百人|ひゃくにん}. For larger numbers: {二百人|にひゃくにん}, {三百人|さんびゃくにん} (note the sound change to びゃく with {三|さん} and {六|ろく}).
